clauses.heading: ## Approved-plan transition hooks
clauses.text: If the authoritative base ledger records `phase: ship` and `merged: true`, resume never re-enters pre-merge `shipping` or treats “nothing to ship” as completion.

clauses.heading: ## Tier 2 — sequential passes
clauses.text: No parallel primitive (or the caller degraded deliberately): run the same work items one at a time, each in a fresh pass with the same prompt and the same output contract.

clauses.heading: ## 14. Self-review
clauses.text: - **Discrimination check** — for every step that compares two things, run the step's own comparison on two controlled fixture pairs.

clauses.heading: ## Gate handling
clauses.text: - Before answering a pending USER gate, require exactly one valid `pending_gate` from `references/progress-schema.md`.

clauses.heading: ## Rules
clauses.text: - Resume sends one answer only when the gate ID, phase, answer class, issue timestamp, absent approval, and absent receipt match.

clauses.heading: ## Step 12: Human Approval Gate
clauses.text: When `release-loop` invoked this skill, atomically set `phase_status: waiting-user` and issue `pending_gate.id: design-approval` before asking.

clauses.heading: ### Release-loop pending disposition
clauses.text: For an interactive final disposition invoked by `release-loop`, atomically set `phase_status: waiting-user` and issue `pending_gate.id: ship-approval` before asking.
